fact: The EC's Director of Electoral Services said the exhibition of the voters register is a critical stage in which voters have the right to object to names on the roll.
The EC released the summary of the certified 2024 voters register: 18,774,159 valid voters, of whom 18,640,811 have biometric data, 131,487 are special voters and 1,870 lack biometric data.

The Electoral Commission's Deputy Commissioner says the 2024 limited registration ran at 268 district offices on an online registration system that prevents double registration, with 251,149 voters registered by day six.

The Electoral Commission exhibited the provisional voters' register at more than 38,000 polling stations in all 268 districts from 20 to 27 August 2024, and voters could also verify details by dialling *711*51#, per the Ghana News Agency.
